rule.n_definition: number of rows in joint eligible chronology

structural_rationale: The earliest approved nominal anchor A02 maps to ceil(n/10).
Choosing w(n)=ceil(n/10) makes A02 exactly the earliest full-window anchor.
Among common backward windows that preserve the earliest approved 10% anchor, this is the maximal observation count.
The rule depends only on joint chronology length and the prospective anchor design, not on Development outcomes, Reference Adequacy results, policy tolerances, Holdout, or Production outcomes.

candidate_domain_binding.anchor_eligibility: mapped N must satisfy N>=w(n) and N<n

semantic_hash_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively lexicographically sorted object keys, compact separators, and semantic_contract_sha256 plus semantic_hash_rule omitted
